account.why: One row per bank account keyed by account_id; disp, loan, order and trans point at it, and its date is the opening date, a business date.

card.why: One row per issued card keyed by card_id, pointing at disp; issued is the card's issue date, a business date on the card.

client.why: One row per bank client keyed by client_id, pointing at district; disp points at it and birth_date is a business date.

disp.why: Links clients to accounts (client_id, account_id) with an OWNER/DISPONENT type on the link; card points at it.

district.why: 77 districts keyed by district_id with name, region and demographic figures; account and client point at it.

loan.why: One loan per account keyed by loan_id, with amount, duration, payments and status; date is when it was granted and the account pointer never repeats.

order.why: Standing payment orders keyed by order_id, pointing at account with recipient bank, account and amount; no time column.

trans.why: One row per account transaction, stamped with date; account_id repeats across about a million rows.
